intent:
This repo is a small static site: one page, index.html, no build step.

Add two things:

1. contact.html — a heading "Contact" and one short paragraph saying questions go to the GitHub repository's issues, plus a link back to index.html.
2. A one-line footer in index.html linking to contact.html. Its wording and whether it sits inside the centered box or under it are open choices, so that task is yours, not a subagent's.

Before you plan, use your own Agent tool once: have an Explore subagent summarize how index.html is built.

Then use your orchestration skill. Write the plan as a task list with a Files: line and a Check: line per task (a grep -q on the file is a fine check), give the plan a project check of its own, and ask me to approve it. Run as a subagent what qualifies, do the other task yourself, and finish the plan the way the skill says.

Publish nothing: no push, no pull request. Match the style of index.html.
title: Static site footer and contact page
